content.bridge_context: We expand our focus from human needs to the broader environment and the recurring patterns (rhythms) in nature.

units.title: Cycles in Nature
units.explanation: Nature follows patterns like Day and Night, Seasons, and the Water Cycle.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the cycle. / चक्र की पहचान करें।

units.title: Animal & Plant Adaptations
units.explanation: Living things change their behavior based on natural rhythms, like migration or hibernation.
units.dual_language_instruction: Match behavior to season. / व्यवहार को मौसम से मिलाएं।
